eng: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

kam: Reid niweethiiwe akivikia mituki ya kilomita 160 kwa isaa mara muonza iulu wa kiao atwaite ngali nini muvai wa AIGP, o ila ingi yitawa wanake mwiu ya ku New Zealand.
eng: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

kam: Asikali ma nthi ya New Zealand manai na ivinda yumu kutumia maasini yoo ya kuthima siviti kwa munduume ukwitwa Reid nundu wa wanake mwiu munini, na ivinda ila asikali matonyie kuthima siviti ya Reid ni ila waendie mbola na kiwango kya 160km/h.
eng: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

kam: Nthĩnĩ wa myaka itatũ mĩvĩtũkũ, avũngwa 80 nĩmalekĩlye kũma nyũmba ya katĩ ya kwĩyandĩkĩthya mate asĩlĩle.
eng: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

eng: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

kam: Komishena nusetiie mbail, kethwa nukunengwa, na aikiithya makosa asu mandikiwe ni musikali ula umukwatie. Makosa asu mandikawa lombyutani ya nthi vala ikoani yiu yatiiawa.
eng: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

eng: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

eng: Chiao and Sharipov reported being a safe distance from the attitude adjustment thrusters.

kam: Ita sya Russia sya nthi nisyakwatisye njeti isu na mwikalile wa kila muthenya ma kisee kyu wasyokewa.
eng: Russian ground control activated the jets and normal attitude of the station was regained.

kam: Ikoani yiu yatwiwe naku Virginia nundu niw'o musyi wa indaneti ila itongoetye AOL, kambuni ila yambiisye ikoani.
eng: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.

kam: Yiĩ nĩyo yila ya mbee ya kũkwata ngatanio kwa nzĩa ya mĩao ila yavitumikithiwe mwaka wa 2003 ya kuũngamya kũtũma e-mail mbingĩ yĩla yĩmwe ila syĩsikie ta spam kuma kwa anyaiicha kũthi kwa masandũkũ ma eene.
eng: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.

kam: Jesus wa myaka mĩongo ĩlĩ na ũmwe ookie Manchester City mwaka mũthelu mwai wa mbee 2017 kuma kĩlavu kya Brazil kya Palmeiras kwa ndĩvi ya milioni £27.
eng: 21-year-old Jesus joined Manchester City last year in January 2017 from Brazilian club Palmeiras for a reported fee of £27 million.

kam: Kuma ivinda yu, muthauki uu wa Brazil athaukite mathauni 53 timuni ino na akavinga mala 24.
eng: Since then, the Brazilian has featured in 53 matches for the club in all competitions and has scored 24 goals.

kam: Ndakitali Lee no wonanisye w'ia wake iulu wa livoti ila syaitye kana syana sya Turkey yu nisikwatitw'e ũwau wa ĩkua ya avian A (H5N1) mate awau.
eng: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

kam: Ni waisye isomo imwe syaasya uwau usu no nginya withe utena vinya mwingi ni kenda uvike nthi yonthe.
eng: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

kam: Ve wia kana awau nomaendee kũkwatya andũ angĩ aingĩ kwa kũkwatĩĩa mawĩa moo ma kĩla mũthenya syonany'a sya homa ĩsu syaendeea kwĩthĩwa ite nthũku mũno.
eng: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

kam: Leslie Aun, mũneeni wa Komen Foundation, aisye kyama kĩu nĩkyosie mwĩao mweũ ũla ũtetĩkĩlasya ũtethyo kana kũnengane mbesa kũnewe syama ila syendee kũkunĩkĩlwa kĩ mĩao.
eng: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

kam: Mũvango wa Komen wakunie maluvuku Planned Parenthood nundu wa ukunikili ula wuendeeye wa undũ Planned Parenthood itumiaa na kũandikithya mbesa syake ula wiikwa ni muungamei Cliff Stearns.
eng: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

kam: Mĩao nĩ kũthĩana na ũmya wa kotĩ kana nĩ ũtũmĩkaa kũtetheesya kũmya mavũ kwĩsĩla kũvanga ũsyaĩ wĩyanĩ wake ta mwene kĩvĩla wa kamĩtĩĩ wa kũsĩsya na kũthĩana na maũndũ, ĩla yĩthaa yĩ ũngũ wa mwavũlĩ wa nyũmba ya vĩnya na kamĩtĩĩ ka mbesa.
eng: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

kam: Gavana wa tene wa Massachusetts Mitt Romney niwasindie usakuani munini wa kyama kya Florida Republican wakeli enda mbee wa 46 percenti ya kula.
eng: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

kam: Muneeni wa tene wa mbunge ya Amerika Newt Gingrich okie namba ili ena kilungu kya 32 ilu wa yiana.
eng: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

kam: Ta kwa nzia ya musindi kwosa syonthe, Florida niyanenganie delegates oonthe me miongo itano kwa Romney, ila yakutwikithisye musĩndi wa usakũani wa Republican Party.
eng: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

kam: Ombany'a ma maandamano asu maisye andu ta 100,000 nimanaumilile misyini ya German ta Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, na Hanover.
eng: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

kam: Ku Berlin, polisi nimatalile andu muatianio wa andu ta 6,500.
eng: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

kam: Maandamano manai nginya o Paris, Sofia kuu Bulgaria, Vilnius kuu Lithuania, Valetta kuu Malta, Tallinn kuu Estonia na Edinburgh na Glasgow kuu Scotland.
eng: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

kam: London andu mavikite 200 ni mekiie mukomo nza wa mauvisi ma eene ma mĩao ya kumĩthya ala anene.
eng: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

kam: Mwei muthelu, kunai maandamano manene kuu Poland ila nthi isu yasainiie ACTA, kula kwatumie silikali ya Polish kuamua kulea kuvitithya wiw'ano usu, kwa oyu.
eng: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

kam: Latvia na Slovakia syeli syi mbola kukwatana na ACTA.
eng: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

kam: Ikundi ya Animal Liberation na yila ya Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals kana RSPCA maendeeye na kwitya kwikiwa kwa lasima kwa kamera sya CCTV mwakoni yoonthe ya kusuvia nyamu ku Australia.
eng: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

kam: Inisipekita kwa isyitwa David O'Shannesy wa RSPCA New South Wales nutavisye ABC kana uthiani ula watwaiw'e wa kusisya nyunyi muvai wa Abbatoirs kyaile kwithiwa no kindu kya kila ivinda ku Australia.
eng: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

kam: “Kamela syaũmulĩka nonginya ikatũma wonany'o kwĩ andũ ala mathũkũmanaa na nyamũ kana maũseo masyo nĩmo me vata vyũ.”
eng: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

kam: Ũkunîkîli wa kûthingitha kwa nthî yonthe wa nthî ya Amelika mavunî woonanisye vayai kûthingitha kwa nthî ya Iceland kyumwanî kyu kyatongoetye.
eng: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

eng: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

kam: Matu maiu mate uko na volokano ni makusiiiwe nthi wa I kiima.

kam: Matu maonanisye utonyi wa kuete kulanilw'a kwa kana mũlipũko waw'o wai uneekika.
eng: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

kam: Luno niyakuite mikono kati wa 120-160 kubik mita ya mauta ila yaanangikie na iuutani nene vamwe na makumbo syamisukuma yalika nanthi kiw'uni.
eng: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

kam: Helikopta yoovoisy’e andũ ikũmi na ilĩ ala mathũkũmaa ndekeni isũ na ũla woomiite aũmiite iyũũ eweka.
eng: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

eng: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

kam: Miao ila ikwendekethwa niyavitukithiwe nyumbani syonthe ili twi 2011.
eng: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

eng: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

kam: Kuvaluka kwa musoa wa keli ula umitye woni wa ulea ngwatano sya aka kwa aka kana aume kwa aume no kuvingue muomo wa mitwaano mithenya ii mbeeni.
eng: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

kam: Kuatiia mutalala usu, HJR-3 nikulilw'a ingi ni ala mekusakua usakuani ula ungi 2015 kana 2016 mekale mutalatalani.
eng: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

kam: Mosindi ma Vautier nza wa kundairect ni vamwe na mukomo wa nzaa twi 1973 iulu wa kila woona ta kusiiwa kwa kisiasa.
eng: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

kam: Niwandokyumendie iulu wake mweene ivukuni ya 1998.
eng: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

kam: Twi 1960s niwasyokie ingi kwa wiyathi mweu wa nthi ya Algeria kusomethya iulu wa kumithya sinema.
eng: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

kam: Mujapani Judola Hitoshi Saito, musindi wa mitila ili sya thaavu sya Olimpic, niwakw'a ena ukuu wa miaka 54.

kam: Kitumi kya kikwu kinatangaasiwe ta kanza ya itema yitawa intrahepatic bile.
eng: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

kam: Akw'iiie ku Osaka muthenya wa wakeli.
eng: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

kam: Ota oũ ũla waĩ mũsĩndĩ wa olympik na nthĩ yonthe, saĩto nĩwe waĩ mũnene ngwatanĩo ya ũmanyĩsya wa Japan judo fedaratĩon.
eng: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

kam: Andû ta 100 nîmanavikie kyamanî kutania ulilikany'o wa mbee wa endwa ala mûtwaano woo waî mwaka mûthelu.

eng: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

eng: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

eng: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

eng: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

kam: O ĩngi ni usikatĩitwe kutula mĩao ya kumĩthya indĩ ndaa na ndaaĩvĩthwa.
eng: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

kam: Mumanyiw'a wa tene aisye kana atumiie “ndeto syavitiwe ni ivinda kilasini, asomethya undu utonya utuma nduu na notes, na ai undumwe na munyanyae wa mumanyiw'a.”
eng: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

kam: Nthînî wa myaka mîongo îtatû mîthelu, ona itina wa kwîthwa yî nthî ya komunisti, Kyaina ninaseuvisye ekonomi ya soko.
eng: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

kam: Maendeeo ma mbee me na uvinduku maetiwe ni utongoi wa Deng Xiaoping.
eng: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

kam: Kuma ivinda yu, saisi ya ekonomi ya Kyaina yianite mavinda 90.
eng: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

kam: Kwa ila ya mbee mwaka muthelu China ni inatee ngali mbingi nthi sya nza kwi Germany na yavita United States ta soko nene ya ngali.
eng: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

kam: GDP ya Kyaina nitonya kwithwa yi nene kwi ya Amelika nthĩnĩ wa myaka mĩongo ĩlĩ.
eng: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

kam: Kĩuutani kya kana kya mwaka wa 2010 kya Atlantic kila kitawa Tropical Storm Danielle ni kyambiie ngaliko ya ũmilo wa sua ya ũkanga wa Atlantic.
eng: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

kam: Kiuutani kyu, kila ki ta maili 3,000 kuma Miami, Florida, yina iseve sya mituki ya maili 40 kwa isaa ila ni kilomita 64 kwa isaa.
eng: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

kam: Masayandisti naku National Hurricane Center matatithisye kana Danielle nukwikia vinya hurricane tuivika Wakatatũ.
eng: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

kam: Undu ngwona storm ii ta yivaasa kuvaluka, ni vinya muno kutatithya impact yayo kwa nthi ya Amelika kana Caribbean.
eng: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

kam: Asyaitwe musyi munene wa Croatia, Zagreb, Bobek akwatie nguma ila wathaukiaa Partizan Belgrade.
eng: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

kam: Alĩkanĩle namo mwakanĩ wa 1945 na ekala mũvaka mwaka wa 1958.

kam: Ĩvindanĩ yake na timũ ĩsu, avingie ngoli 403 iulu wa moonekano 468.
eng: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

kam: Vai mundu o na umwe waa umila mavinda maingi kana kuvunga mbao mbingi kuvita Bobek kilavuni.
eng: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

kam: Mwakanĩ wa 1995 nĩwakũnĩiwe kũla ta mũthaũkĩ mũseo wa isitoli ya Partĩzan.
eng: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

kam: Kyathĩ kyambĩĩe na kũtanĩthw'a kwa mwanya nĩ kĩkũndĩ cha cĩrqũe dũ solelĩ.
eng: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

kam: Yatiiwe ni Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, mbandi ya Jannissary, na aini Fatih Erkoḉ na Müslüm Gürses.

kam: Dervishes ila syi wasya nisyo sinai sitengyi.

eng: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

eng: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

kam: Peter Lenz, ndeleva wa mathau ma mota na ula wina ukuu wa myaka 13, niwatiwa ni thayu itina wa kukwata mbanga leluni wa mathau asu ku Indianapolis.
eng: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

kam: E laũndini ya mwambililyo, Lenz avalũkie kuma kisululuni kyake, na ningi akũnwa ni mutwai kisululu ungi Xavier Zayat.
eng: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

kam: Anaiitiwe o kwa mituki ni ndakitali ila syithwaa nziani na akuwa atwawa sivitali ula wi vakuvi vala itina wakwie.
eng: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

kam: Zayat ndaaumia.
eng: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

kam: Lulu wa maundu ma ki mbesa ma nthi yonthe, Zapatero niwaendeeie ka kwiasya kana “walany'o wa ki mbesa ni kilungu kimwe kya muvangile wa mbesa, kilungu kya vata.
eng: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

kam: Twina thina muasa wa mwaka umwe wa ilovia, ula wai vathuku muno myei ili mithelu, na nisuania yu masoko ma mbesa nimambiie kuseuva.”
eng: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

kam: Kyumwa kithelu, mauvoo ma Naked mataangasie kana nimekwongela ithyomo syoo sya nthi yonthe kwa kumanyithya andu mauvoo, mena isese itatu nzau.
eng: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

kam: Kambuni ino ya nthi syonthe ila yatumiaa English na Japanese ni kwambiisya kutumia Spanish, Italian na Korean nthi wa TV, web na simu.
eng: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

kam: Kwa vaati nzeo o na vai kindu kyaa ngitikia, indi ninoonie kindu kya kyeva, yila andu matataa kuaa ioo maumaale.
eng: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

kam: Andu makunaa isisyo sya na ivila, indi ndilisya siai syatuka.
eng: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

kam: “ĩmwe katĩ wa ndĩlĩsya nĩsyaanangĩkĩe na maĩtũmĩa kũthĩ nza”, Franciszek Kowal ũmwe katĩ wa ala mavĩtĩe nĩwaisye.
eng: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

kam: Ndata syumasya kyeni na muutîa nûndû wa vinya ula umaa ila syuma sya hyndrogyeni syavulanw'a (kana kukwatanw'a) vamwe kuseuvya syuma îngi ngito.
eng: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

kam: Asomi ma saienzi ni meumanya kindu kiseovya vinya ta uu kwa nzia ii.
eng: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

kam: Ũũ, o na vamwe na ũu, nĩ thĩna mũnene mũno kũmanthĩa ũsũngĩo na ũkaakua myaka mingĩ mbee wa tũtanona syĩndũ sya ũseuvya vinya wa mwaki sya vata syakĩtwe.
eng: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

kam: Singano ulelaa iulu wa kiw'u nundu wa surface tension.
eng: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

kam: vĩnya wa kĩw'ũ wĩthĩawa wĩmũlũmũ nũndũ kĩw'ũ kĩthĩawa kĩkwatanĩte mũno kũteũndũ kĩkwatanĩte na nzeve yĩũlũ wa kyo.
eng: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

kam: Twindu twa kiwu tutumaa tuseuvya kikonde kitekwoneka iulu wa kiwu kila kituma syindu ta singano u vuloti yiulu wa kiwu.
eng: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

kam: Ũtee wa kasamũ ka ũtwaĩa mbalavunĩ wĩthĩaa na ndee ilĩ syĩna ĩima ya mũvilingo katĩ katĩ wa sy'o. Ndee isu ilĩ situmaa ũkwati wa mbalavu wĩthĩwa mũseango, o na syĩ mbalyũũle.
eng: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

kam: Nũndũ mũthya wa kawembe nĩwĩkũmbĩte vanĩnĩ, kawembe kasonga saĩndĩ ĩmwe kana ĩla ĩngĩ, mũthya ũla ũtĩnene na ĩw'a nĩwĩkũmbaa.
eng: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

kam: Kĩĩ kĩtũmaa skaters mavĩndũka. Ĩmbw'a skates syavĩndũka syasisya kw'oko kwa aũme, skater ndavĩndũka ndasisya kw'oko kwa aũme, skates syavĩndũka syasisya kw'oko kwa aka, skater ndasĩsya kw'okonĩ kwa aka.
eng: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

kam: Nikana itunge vinyani wasyo wa mbeeni, no nginya silekasya vinya usu wi yiulu ula syakwatie kuma kyenini kyu.
eng: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

kam: mekaa ũũ kwĩsĩla kũmya kaĩndo kanĩnĩ vyũ ka kyenĩ ketawa “photon”.
eng: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

kam: Andu ma saenzi metaa nzia ii “stimulated emission ya radiation” nundu atomu syithwaa syi stimulated ni kyeni kingí, vakatuma photon sya kyeni syuma, na kyeni ni muthemba wa radiation.
eng: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

kam: Ivisa ila yiatiie yionany'a atoms iyumya protons. Na kwa uw'o protons syithwaa syi o nini vanini kwi isu syi visani.
eng: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

kam: Protons ona syithwa syi niini kuvita syindu ila iseuvitye atomu!
eng: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

kam: Itina wa masaa maana ma uthukumi koma ka ngulovu mwisowe nikaunguie na I ngulovu yaeka kwakana.
eng: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

kam: Ngulovu nĩyendaa ukuanw'a ingĩ. Nuseo kwisuvia ila uukuany'a I ngulovu.
eng: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

kam: Mbee, swikyi ya ithau ya kyeni yienda amba uvow'a kana waya ukuuwe.
eng: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

kam: Uu nundu mwaki wa sitima undu ulikite soketini vala paati isu ya kyuma yii na ngulovu yukaa ukomeea no yiukune shoko kethwa nuukwata nthini wa soketi kana kwa base ya kyuma kya ngulovu o ila yikwatene na soketi.
eng: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

kam: Imutha yi vata muno ya circulatory system ni ngoo, ila ikunaa nthakame.
eng: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

kam: Nthakame yumaalukilaa tiuvuni witawa arteries na yîisyokela tiuvuni syitawa mikiva. Tiuvu ila miniini vyu yitawa capillaries.
eng: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

kam: Maeo ma triceratops mei matonya utilany'a o na ti matu me moka ateo nginya maka na mii myetu.
eng: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

kam: Asomi amwe ma sainzi masuaniaa kana ndainoso syaie miti ya maliu na ndawa, ila muthemba wa miti wakwatikanaa muno Cretaceous.
eng: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

kam: Miti isu yielye minathi nini yina miva mbũi na matu meutonyana.
eng: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

kam: Triceratops yai itonya kutumia munyuka wayo mulumu kuya matu itanamba kuya itina ya muti usu.
eng: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

kam: Andu ma Saienzi measya miti ino yi sumu mwingi na vaitonyeka kwitha ndainosa ya miisaa, ona vala umunthi ve nyamu simisaa kwa ngelekany'o kasuku (usyao wa ndainosa) niyiisaa matu kana matunda me sumu.
eng: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

kam: Vinya wa Io, utonya kungusya ata? Ukaelya kuungama iulu wa Io, uito waku wailite kwithiwa wi munini mbee wa uito waku wi kuu nthi.
eng: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

kam: Mundu wa uito wa paundi 200 vaa nthi atonya kuma paundi 36 kuya Io. Kwoou vinya ula ukusasya syindu syelekele nthi, ku withiawa wi muoleku.
eng: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

kam: Sua yii vandũ vomũ va kũungama ta nthi ino. Sua yiseovetwe na nzeve, mwaki na ũsũu (plasma).
eng: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

kam: Nzeve iendeeaa na kuvutha o undu uendete vaasa na sua.
eng: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

kam: Ngalĩko ya nza ĩla twonaa twasyaĩsya syũa ĩĩtawa protosphere, nĩkw'o kwasya “mũvĩla wa kyeni”.
eng: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

kam: Ta myaka ngili itatũ ĩtinanĩ, mwakani wa 1610, mũsoomi wa ndata wa Italy Galileo Galilei aatũmĩie kamasini ka kwonan'ya syĩndũ syi kuasa nesa kwona kana Venus ithiawa na ilungu, o ta ũndũ mwai wĩthĩawa.
eng: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

kam: Mavinda mekîkaa nûndû tû no ngalîko ya Venus (kana ya mwei) îla îng'ethanîsye na syûa yîna kyeni. Mavinda ma Venus nîmakwataa mbau ngewa ya Copernicus îla yasyaa kana vulaneti nithyûlûlûkîte syûa.
eng: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

kam: îndî, myaka minini itina twî 1639, astronoma umwe wa muvai wa mûûsûngû wetawa Jeremiah Horrocks niwoonie transit ya Venus.
eng: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

kam: Uungelesa ni ya kwatie muuo wa kilungu kiasa itina ya kukilya vinya ingi Danelaw.
eng: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

kam: O na vamwe na uu mwakani wa 991 Ethelred akomanie na nguthu ya asikali nene kwi ingi yonthe kuma ila ya Guthrum myaka iana mbeeni.
eng: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

kam: Matongoiwe ni Olaf Trygvasson wa Norweg ula waina wendi wa kwosa nthi yake kuma mokoni ma Denmark.
eng: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

kam: Itina wa syindu sya kuaa ngoo sya a jeshi sya mbee, Ethelred niwai na utonyi wa kwitikilana na mawendi ma Olaf, ula wasyokie Norway kutatithya kwosa usumbi wake ena usindi muvulany'e.
eng: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

kam: Kithyomo kya Hangeul ni kyo kithyomo ki kyoka kila kyaseuvisye na kitumi. Kyaseuvisye mwaka wa 1444 ivinda ya Musumbi Sejong (1418-1450).
eng: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

kam: Mũsumbĩ Sejong aĩ mũsumbĩ wa kana wa Ũsumbĩ wa Joseon na ũmwe wa ala mane'twe ndaĩa mũno.
eng: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

kam: Mwambililyoni eetie muvango usu wa ndeto wa Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, ila niyo “mawasya ala maw'o ma uvundusya andu”.
eng: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

kam: Ve ngewa mbingi sya undu Sanskrit wasyaiwe. Imwe ni kuthama kwa Aryan kuma ngaliko ya uthuilo wa sua kuka India na ala mookie na kithyomo kyoo.
eng: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

kam: Sanskrit ni kithyomo kya tene na kivw'ananithw'a na Kilatino kila kinaeenawa Yulovu kikyoka.
eng: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

kam: Ivuku yila ya tene muno yisikie iulu wa nthi yaandikiwe Sanskrit. Itina wa kukwatanwa na Upanishads, Sanskrit yathelile vyu.
eng: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

kam: Sanskrit ni kithyomo kimwe kivinya na kithw'ii, kila kithiitwe ta mwabiliilyo wa ithyomo mbingi sya matuku aa sya India, o undu Latini niyo mwambiliilyo wa ithyomo sya asungu ta kivalanza na kiisipania.
eng: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

kam: Kaũ wa kũũkitĩa France wĩ mũthelu, Germany yaambĩsye kwiyũmbany'a kuvithukia kithama kya Uungelesa.
eng: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

kam: Germany yatwie kũvithũkĩwa kyu isyitwa ya “Operation Sealion”. Míio mingi ngito ya asikali ma ita ma úúngelesa yai inaa ila maumiw'e kuma Dunkirk, kwoou ita ndyai na vinya muno.
eng: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

kam: Indi a jeshi ma kiw'uni ma usumbi mai o na vinya mwingi kwii ajeshi ma kiw'uni ma Germany (“Kriegsmarine”) na mai matonya kwananga aliki onthe ma vinya matumitwe kwisila nzia ya Kisungu.
eng: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

kam: O na vamwe na uu, meli o nini sya jeshi ya kiusumbi nosyo syaungeemw'e vakuvi na nzia ila syai itonya utumiwa kulikililwa na vinya nundu anene ma jeshi ya kiw'uni ni maakiaa kwisa ulikywa kiw'uni ni kau wa nzeveni wa a German.
eng: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

kam: Twambiisye na kuelesya mivango ya Italy. Italy yai muinae wa Germany na Japan.
eng: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

kam: Ita syake sya nthi mbumu na kiwuni syai mbozu ona vala ni yaakite meli inya nzau kau utanamba ambiia.
eng: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

kam: Ieleelo nene sya Itali syai nthi sya Avilika. Kukwata nthi isu, mendaa ithwa na kikosikya kya asikali, nikenda kikosi kyu kisile ukanga wa Mediterranean na meivivúkia Avilika.
eng: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

kam: Kwondu wa uu, mai no mavetangaa vyu ngome sya asungu ku Misili. Eka kiu, meli sya kau sya Itali iyaaile ukuna wia ungi.
eng: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

kam: Oyu undu wa Japan. Japan kyai kithama, ta Britain.
eng: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

kam: Meli sya ungu wa kiwu iseuvitwe kwisila ungu wa kiwu, na syikalaa vau kwa ivinda yiasa.
eng: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

kam: Meli sya kaũ ni syatumiiwe kaũni wa mbee wa nthi yonthe na wa keli. Ivinda yiũ syai na mbola muno na syaumasya mavuti mbola.
eng: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

kam: Mwambiioni wa kaũ matembeaa muno ulũ wa ukanga indĩ ila ngasi yaambie kuseuvya na kitha nyĩ nzeo maendie nthini wa kiwũ ni kenda maikonekane.
eng: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

kam: Meli sya Germany syeetawa U-boat. Andu ma Germany ni matembeaa kiwuni nesa na nimatwaa meli syoo nesa.
eng: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

kam: Nundu wa kwona nesa na submarinezi, itina wa kaũ andu ma Germani mayiikika kwithiwa nasyo mbingi.
eng: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

kam: Yii! Musumbi Tutankhamun, ula saaingi witawa “Musumbi Tut” kana “Musumbi kimwana” numwe kati wa ala me nguma ma tene na asumbi ma Misili ma ivinda yii.
eng: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

kam: Kwendeesya, ndoneka ekĩtũmĩ kĩnene ĩvĩnda ya tene na ndaĩ mũandĩke mũno mavũkũnĩ ma asũmbĩ matene.
eng: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

kam: Onou wiovo, kuvumbuwa kwa kavuli kake mwaka wa 1922 ni kwamunengie nguma muno. O yila tuvuli twingi twavithukiawa na kuywa, kavuli kaa katyaakiitwa ni mundu.
eng: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

kam: Syĩndũ mbĩngĩ ila ithikĩtwe syĩna Tũtankhamũn nĩsyasuviiwe nesa, vamwe na makili ma mavisa ma kwasa maseũvĩtwe kũma syũmanĩ na mavĩanĩ me mwoo.
eng: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

kam: Kukundua kwa ndia sya waya kwatumie makasya ma Assyria mavutha, mituki, na kwithwa issemba mituki kwi asikali na makasya ala angi.
eng: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

kam: maangĩ kũma mbũtanĩ syoo nthũkũ mũno nosyĩtonye maĩma ona kwĩsĩla ĩsĩĩnĩ syoo sya kũkita sya asĩkalĩ moo.ta 1000 B.C., Asĩlĩa nĩmambĩĩsye ita syambee sya kũkita syĩ mbalasĩnĩ.
eng: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

kam: Cavalry ni yeshi ila yukitaa yi muongoni wa mbalasi. Saddle iyambite kuseuvwa, kwoou cavalry ya Assyria yokitie miongoni nthei ya mbalasi kyoo.
eng: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

kam: Nitwisi anasiasa aingi ma ukiliki anasayanzi, na asanii. Muno muno mundu ula wisikie muno kwa kithio kii ni Homer, mutungi usu wi nguma wa shaili, ula waandikie utungi wi mwanya isomoni ya Kikiliki: shaili ta Iliad na Odyssey.
eng: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

kam: Sophocles na Aristophanes ni aandiki ma mathau mesikie na mathau moo ni mosawa ta amwe kati wa ala maseo ma kuandikwa.
eng: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

kam: Mũndũ ũngĩ wĩ ngũma mũno wa Greek nĩ mwĩkĩ wa masavũ Pythagoras, ũla wĩsĩkanĩe mũno kwa mwĩao wake wa kũtaanya kwa ngalĩko sya triangle yĩ kona ĩmwe yĩ ndikilii mĩongo kenda.
eng: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

kam: Kwi utalo kivathũkany'o wa ũtalo wa andũ ala maneneenaa Kihindi. Ni kitalitwe kwitha kithyomo kya keli kana kya kana kwa ithyomo ila syineenawa mũno iũlu wa nthi.
eng: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

kam: Namba ya andu ala maneenaa kithyomo kyoo nisenzasya na itengemeaa kethwa mineenele yoo ithengeanie no italwe.
eng: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

kam: Wĩanany'o wĩ katĩ wa aneeni milioni 340 ĩna nginya milioni 500, na kuvikiia andu milioni 800 no maelewa kĩthyomo kĩu.
eng: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

kam: Hindi na Urdu nundumwe kwa undu siumini ateo ni kivathukany'o kwa kuandika; kwa kuneena kwa kila muthenya, aneeni ma syeli nomew'ane.
eng: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

kam: Myakani ya 1500 kĩthĩo cha Estonia ya Yiulũ chaalyũkitwe ni Germany.
eng: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

kam: Mamonks amwe ma german meenda kũete ngaĩ vakũvĩ na andũ moo, na kwoũ maseũvya kĩthyomo kya estonĩan.
eng: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

kam: Yaseuvitw'e kuma kwi namba sya Germany na namba imwe “~O/~o” yongelwa.
eng: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

kam: O ivinda yiendete, ndeto mbingi ila syaumiw'e kuma German coalesced. Uu niw'o wai mwambiio wa umanyi.
eng: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

kam: Kawaita, ula ukwosa kivila aile uthi imwe kwa ita itina wa umina sukulu.
eng: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

kam: O vailye uu, Charles aendie kimanyisyo kinene kya Trinity College, Cambridge vala wasomeie Antropology na Archaeology, na itina history, akwete 2:2 (ndikilii ya kilasi kya keli kya nthi).
eng: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

kam: Charles niwe wai memba wa mbee wa nyumba isu ya kiusumbi ya Britain kunengwa ndikilii.
eng: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

kam: Turkey (Thrace ya umilo wa sũana Rumelia nthi wa Balkan Peninsula) yithiawa 3 iũlũ wa 100 ya nthi isũ.
eng: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

kam: Kĩsio kya Turkey nĩ kĩnene kũvita ilomita 1,600 (1,000 mi) ũasa na ilomita 800 (500 mi), kĩna mũvyanũ wa kona ĩnya.
eng: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

kam: Kîsio kya Turkey, vamwe na îia, yosete mwanya wa sikwea wa kilomita 783,562 (300,948 sq mi), o vala sikwea sya kilomita 755,688 (291,773 sq mi), syingaliko ya itheo ya kwoko kwa aka wa nthi ya Asia na sikwea sya kilomita 23,764 (9,174 sq mi) ku Europe.
eng: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

kam: Isio sya Turkey nisyo namba 37 kwithwa syi nene nthi yonthe, na ni vakuvi na saisi wa Metropolitan France na Uungelesa ikwatanitw'e.
eng: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

kam: Turkey ithyululitwe ni ukanga ngaliko itatu: Ũkanga wa Aegean ngaliko ya ulwe, Ukanga mwiu ngaliko ya iulu na ukanga wa Mediterranean ngaliko ya itheo.
eng: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

kam: Luxembourg yina isitoli ndaasa indi yaekie kuungamiwa kuma 1839.
eng: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

kam: Ivindani ya umunthi ngaliko imwe sya Belgium syai sya Luxembourg kuma ivindani ya tene ateo yatwikie Belgian itina wa 1830s ila Belgium yokitie.
eng: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

kam: Luxembourg yiendekethetye kwithwa yi nthi itendete ngaliko imwe ateo andu nimatuie vo ivindani ya kau wa mbee na wa keli ni Germany.
eng: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

kam: Twî 1957 Luxembourg niyatwikie memba wa organization ila umunthi yisikie ta ngwatanio ya Europe.
eng: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

kam: Drukgyal Dzong ni nyumba nene muno mbanangiku yi nthi wa utongoi wa Buddha ngalikoni ya iulu ya kivalo kya Paro (utui wi Phondey).
eng: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

kam: Vatwikanaa kana twi 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel niwaakie tauni ya tene nikenda atanie usindi wake iulu wa isalu sya Tibetan-Mongol.
eng: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

kam: Mwaki wa 1951 niwatialilye matialyo amwe ma Drukgyal Dzong kwa ngelekany'o ivisa ya Zhabrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

kam: Itina wa mwaki, ngome isu niyaiiwe yi nzuviiku, iitalikana ta imwe ya moseo ala makusasya atalii ku Bhutan.
eng: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

kam: Ivindani ya sengyali ya 18 Cambondia yeeyithiie ivinyiitwe kati wa atu eli me vinya, Thailand na Vietnam.
eng: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

kam: A Thai malikie na vinya Cambodia maita maingi muno myakani ya maana ikumi na nyanya na kwi mwaka wa 1772 maananga Phnom Phen vyu.
eng: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

kam: Myakanĩ ya mũthia ya sengyalĩ ya 18 andũ ma Vietnam o namo nĩmavithũkĩie Cambodia.
eng: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

kam: 18% ya andu ma venezuela mayithaa na wia, na aingi ma andu ala me wiani muthukumaa ivalua.
eng: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

kam: Ene nthi ma Venenzuela ala ni ilí íúlú wa itatu ala mathukumaa nimekaa úu kwa sekita isu, vakuvi na kwota ya wía miveani isu na imwe íúlú wa itano mathukumaa kwa anglikasa.
eng: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

kam: Muvea museo wa ene nthi ma Venezuela ni mauta, vala nthi isu nitesaa mauta nthi ingi, o na kutwika ni vaasendi imwe kwa muvea usu.
eng: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

kam: Tene kwa wĩyathĩ wa nthĩ ĩsũ, ataalamũ ma mĩũnda ya Singapore matetheeĩsye kũvĩndũa kĩthũkũma kĩũ kyatwĩkũ mũũnda mũnene wa nthĩ ĩsũ.
eng: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

kam: Twi 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, ilaa ya aibrid niyo yasakuiwe ta ilaa ya nthi isu.
eng: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

kam: Kila mwaka vaaya ta mwaini wa ikumi vakuvi nyamu milioni 1.5 ila iisaa matu nisyelekelaa uini wa ngali sya itheo, iikila usi wa Mara, kuma iimani sya iulu kwoondu wa mbua.
eng: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

kam: Na indi iisyoka ngaliko ya iulu yisilite ngaliko ya uthuiloni wa sua, iikila usi wa Mara ingi itina wa mbua ya mwai wa Kana.
eng: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

kam: Kĩsĩonĩ kya serengetĩ kĩna vandũ va nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ serengetĩ, kĩsĩo kĩvathe kya Ngorongoro na maswa game reserve nthĩ ya Tanzanĩa na vandũ va nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ maasaĩ mara kenya.
eng: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

kam: Kumanya kuseovya nzia sya kumanyana kwendaa umanyi wa unduũ syindũ syialyũkite na syithio vamwe na syindũ ila isomawa ilasini sya kũmanyana (kwatianisya mavisa, kuseuvya vindio na wasya, kuea ngewa na ingi.
eng: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

kam: Ndisaini ya mituki yendaa ukasisya ingi ngewa ite na uw'o iulu wa ivindi sya kumya maumoo na kumanya kwisilya nziani syi kivathukany'o.
eng: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

kam: Nzĩa sya ũvũlano syendaa ĩseũvya sya wĩa kwĩtha syĩna ũũmwe, na ĩngĩ syaĩle kwĩtha kĩla ĩmwe ĩtonya kũeleeka yĩoyoka.
eng: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

kam: Kĩtelemo kya'ũlika ĩngĩ kyũkaa mĩtũkangĩ kwĩ kĩtelemo kya syĩthĩo (nĩvethĩawa ĩvinda ĩnini ya ũthũmũa na ũtaanĩa), yĩkalangaa mũno, na noyĩthĩwe nthũku mũnango.
eng: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

kam: Kii ti kindu kya usumbua nundu andu ala maseuvasya malenzi methwaa mathimite kilasi kya iulu ila mekuseuvya I lenzi.
eng: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

kam: Kii ni kitonyethyete lenzi sya kuthengeesya syindũ syũmya visa nzeo kũte ila syitakunitwe na lenzi ya kuthengeesya syindu.
eng: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

kam: Undu ungi muthuku wa lenzi sya kunzuum ni kana aparture ila ithwaa na mwiso (siviti) ya lenzi yithwaa yi nthi.
eng: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

kam: Ii iseuvasya lenzi itembesa mbingi itatumika nesa ila wi vandu vate kyeni nesa na utena flashi.
eng: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

kam: Kĩmwe kya mathĩna ala methĩawa mũno ĩla mũndũ ũkũvĩndũa movĩe kũthĩ kwa DVD nĩkũvĩndũa mala maĩngĩ.
eng: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

kam: Tiivii mbingî iseûvîtw'e itanîthye wanda.
eng: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

kam: Kwa kitumi kiu, kindu kyonthe wonaa kwa TV kyai na mivaka, iulu, itheo na ngaliko.
eng: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

kam: Kii kikawa kuikiithya kana ivisa yu niyausua kioo kiima. Kii nikyo kitawa overscan.
eng: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

kam: Kwa vaatĩĩ nthũkũ, ĩla ũseũvya DVD, syĩndĩ ĩla syĩ vakũmĩ na mũthya sĩyũmĩlaa, na etha yĩ vĩsa yũ ya vĩndĩo yĩna maandĩko vakũvĩ na mũthya ngalĩko ya nthĩ, maandĩko asũ mayonekanaa onthe.
eng: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

kam: Medieval ii ya uthaukia yiilye ya tene nithuthitye kuimangini, ietete mavisa, banquets na Arthurian chivalry.
eng: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

kam: Ona ũkaũngama katĩ ya mĩako mianangĩkũ yĩkalĩte vandũ va mĩaka ngili ũmwe nĩ laisi kũsũanĩa na kũete akilini mawasya na mĩnyũngo ya kaũ sya ũkĩtĩw'e tene, ngĩnya ũkesa ĩthĩa no wĩw'e mbalasĩ ĩtembeete na wĩa kũma avũngwanĩ.
eng: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

kam: Indi, masuania maitu me iulu wa uw'o? W'o niki nyumba sya asumbi syaakiwe? Syaseuviw'e na kwakwa ata?
eng: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

kam: Ituteny'e nda ivinda yii, Kirby Muxloe Castle ni ta nyumba nzeo kwi castle ya w'o.
eng: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

kam: Ndilisa syake mbize na nguta mbonzu siyaisyisiiya kũvithukĩwa kwa kĩlũngũ kĩasa.
eng: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

kam: myakanĩ ya 1480, ĩla mwako wambĩĩĩwye nĩ mũsũmbĩ Hastĩngs, nthĩ ĩsũ yaĩna mũũo na ita syendekana nũndũ wa tũkũndĩ tũnĩnĩ twa Maraũders.
eng: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

kam: Kwĩanany'a vinya yaĩ nthĩa ĩla nthĩ sya Europe syatũmĩie kũtatĩthya kwiia ũnene wa nthĩ syonthe sya Europe.
eng: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

kam: Mũvango wai kana nthĩ syonthe sya Ũsũngũnĩ syaĩlĩlwe nĩ kũsiĩa nthĩ ĩmwe ndĩkethĩwe na vinya mwingĩ, na kwoou silikalĩ sya nthĩ syonthe nĩsyalyũlaa ngwatanĩo syasyo kĩla ĩvinda nĩkana syĩkale sikwatĩĩe ũu.
eng: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

kam: Kau wa utianiwa wa Spanish niw'o wai kau wa mbee ula wai na kieleelo kya kumbalanzi vinya.
eng: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

kam: Uu wai undu wai vata kwa uvinduku, ta vinya wa European ndukethwaa vo mayifanya nimesi ungai muno na kau. Indi, myaka miongo itatu ya kau yithwa wi kau wa muthya wa kau wa kiindini.
eng: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

kam: Ikalu ta Artemis yila yi Ephesus ni yaanangiwa matuku 21 mwai wa Muonza, 356 BCE ila yakwatiwe mwaki ni Herostratus.
eng: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

kam: Kwianana na I ngewa, musukumo wake wai nguma kwa nzia syonthe. Aeveso, me athatu, ni matangaanzie kana isyitwa ya Herostratus yiikaa andikwe.
eng: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

kam: Mundu wa tene wa Greek, Strabo niwawetie isyitwa yila tutumiaa umunthi. Ikalu ni yanaangiwe wioo ula Alexander the Great wasaiwe.
eng: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

kam: Alexander ta musumbi, ni weenyumisye kuipa ikalu yakwe ingi indi andu ni maleile. Ikalu yii yaakiwe ingi itina wa Alexander kwitwa 323 BCE.
eng: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

kam: Ikiithya kw'oko kwaku ni kuleelu undu vatonyeka o mbato uendee uthauka noti isu nesa- na ingi ndukatate kwikala uisongya syaa syaku muno na vinya.
eng: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

kam: Uu yu, nûûnoa o vanini. Lilikana vai vata wa utina mbunguo utumiite vinya mwingi nikenda wîw'e wasya wongeleka ta kwa piano.
eng: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

kam: Kinandani, nikana ukwate wasya wa iulu, utumiaa tuwaya tula twi uthing'ito kana mituki mbingaingi.
eng: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

kam: Masũanĩa mataeleeka nĩ kũatĩĩa ũũmwe, ũmanyĩkani, kana kũmanya wi makini kwa ũw'o wa vyũ, ũ'Ngai, ũw'o wa kĩĩveva, kana Ngai.
eng: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

kam: Mũĩkĩi amanthaa ũmanyĩ waw'o, mĩw'ĩle, kana kũelewa mũno kwa ũw'o mũtheũ/ũngaĩ.
eng: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

kam: Aatĩĩ maatĩaa maũndũ mana ma mwĩkalĩle, kana mĩĩkile ya maũndũ ĩla yaĩlĩtwe kwĩ maũndũ asu.
eng: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

kam: Mysticism no ivathukanw'e kuma kwa uikii ungi wa ndini na kuthaitha kwa kulilya utuika wa mundu we mweene kwoondu ukwiyiw'a, muno muno ala ma muuo, woni, useo, o na mwikalo wa ecstatic.
eng: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

kam: Ukalasinga ni ndini kuma condineti nini ya Aindi. Yumite kuu Punjab ivindani ya sengyali ya 15 kuma vala matilikanile nthini wa kithio kya Hindu.
eng: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

kam: Kalasinga monaa muikiio woo wi kivathukany'o na Hinduism ateo nimetikilaa maumite kwa Hindu na kithio kyoo.
eng: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

kam: Andu ma Sikh metaa ndini yoo Gurmat, ila ni Punjabi kwa “nzia ya guru”.Guru kindu kya vata kwa ndini sya Aindi indi nthi wa Sikhism mwanya munene ula useovasya muikiio wa Sikh.
eng: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

kam: Ndini isu yambiliiilw'e mwakani senjali ya 15 ni Guru Nanak kuma 1469-1539. Ni vaatiie kwa vakuvi alimu angi keenda.
eng: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

kam: Ona uu wiovo, mwaka wa 1956, mawatho ma Krushchevs nimeekiiwe mutianini yila maandamano maumbukie ku Poland, athukumi maileana na unyivu wa liu na kuolwa kwa misaala, yavindukie na watw'ika muatianio wa kuleana na ukomyunisiti.
eng: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

kam: Ona kwĩthĩwa muthianĩ, Krushchev nĩwatumie matangi kũtũngĩĩsya mũuo, nĩwanengie wendi na tamaa ya kĩmbesa mwanya waũnyuva Wladyslaw Gomulka ũla wesĩwe mũno nĩ kana ethĩwe mũũngamũũ wa silikalĩ.
eng: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

kam: Kualyulwa ki umunthi kwa Kyanda kya Indus kwai kualyulwa kwa ivindani ya kati kuu kiseseni kya India ya iulu kuthyuukite kilungu kinene kya pakistani ya umunthi na ilungu ingi sya ulweni wa iulu wa India na umothoni wa iulu wa Afghanistan.
eng: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

kam: Kĩsomo kyaendeeie mbũsĩnĩ sya ĩndũs vala yaũmĩsye ĩsyĩtwa yayo.
eng: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

kam: O na kau asomi amwe measyaa kana tondu ualyuulo wa iliko na maisha ma andu kuvikiia maisha ma umunthi no waii kw'o utee was usi ula mulau oyu wa Sarasvati, wailile kwitwa mituki ualyulo-wa-Sarasvati, kuu namo angi maikwita ualyulo wa Harappa itina wa Harappa, vala vai vandu va, mbee musyini usu kwinzwa myakani ya 1920.
eng: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

kam: Usumbiko wa ta ita wa usumbi wa Lomu niwatetheeisye kutwaa mbee maendeeo ma uiiti.
eng: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

kam: Ndakitali syambiiw'e kuandikwa ni Emperor Augustus na ona maseuvya Roman Medical Corps ma mbee ma kutumia itina wa kau.
eng: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

kam: Matakitali ma uthinzi maina umanyi wa ndawa syi kivathukany'o syivo movaini ila yumaa ngiini sya popi na kopolamaini kuma ngiini sya ambeini.
eng: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

kam: Ni matwikite me aseo muno kwa utila awau mamutha kumavonokya kuma kwa ganrene vamwe na tourniquets na mwikiva kuvunga nikenda nthakame yieke kuma.
eng: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

kam: Kwa sengyali kauta, unene wa Roman watumie ukwati munene muveani wa ndawa na weethwa na umanyi mwingi ula twisi umunthi.
eng: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

kam: Kukunza mathangu kwa pureland ni kukunza mathangu kwi miao kana no ikunza yimwe yitonya kwikwa kwa ivinda yimwe, makunza momu munango ta kukunza na itina timetikile, na makunza monthe methiawa kunduni kwenekee.
eng: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

kam: Yasooviwe ni John Smith mwaka wa 1970s itetheesye andu ala matena umanyi mwingi wa kukunza kana ala matena utonyi munene wa kuthukuma na moko.
eng: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

kam: Syana nisyambiaa umanya iulu wa mûvai wa mundu na undu uilye muvaî syi nini na undu uu ni uaffectiaa mwikalo wasyo.
eng: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

kam: Kwa ngelekany'o, syana ila imanyikanaa kwisila kwa muvai ula munini ula ukonanaw'a na kwithwa mate aseo sukulu mavinda maingi nimavalukaa sukulu ila mamanya kana nimakonanaw'a na undu usu wa muvai woo.
eng: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

kam: MySpace niw'o mutandao wa katatu kwa kumanyikana ku Amelika na kwa oyu wina aatiii milioni 54.
eng: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

kam: Websites ii syithwaa na undu wa kuatiiwa muno, muno muno kwa ngaliko ya kisomo.
eng: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

kam: Ve moseo ma mitandao ii, ila ni vamwe na, kwithiwa utonya kwambiisya mathangu ala ni ta mbulongo, vindio, visa, na syindu ingi mbingi.
eng: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

kam: veengyi ii noumyone kwisila kwa kunengane web andresi o imwe tu, kila kitumaa yithwa yi laisi kumililikana na ingi kuandika laisi kwa amanyiw'a ala methwa na thina wa kutumia kiimboti kana kwa kuendelesya.
eng: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

kam: No iseuvwe ni kinda withie no usome na langi mwingi kana munini undu ukwenda.
eng: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

kam: Uwau wa kuvungula kwa kwithukiisya nesa “ni uwau wa kiakili ula mawonany'o maw'o ni mbuka, kuvuavuana, na kutethya wia saa syonthe kana vinya mwingi”.
eng: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

kam: Ti kuemwa nikusoma, ni uwau wa kusoma; “yikwataa syana syonthe ta vaasendi ya 3 nginya 5, noethwa no mbingi ta milioni 2 kwa syana sya Amelika”.
eng: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

kam: Syana ila syina ADD ni siemawa kũtũnga ilĩko syoo wiani wa sukulu, indi ni nisyitũnga ilĩko syinduni ila syendete ika ta kuthauka na kusyiisya katuni kana kuandika ilungu syitena ikomo.
eng: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

kam: Syana isu nisyonaa thina mwingi muno. Nundu “syithaa na tavia kya muisyo munene muno, ikokita na syii tata ukumu” nikana yiamusye kiliko, nundu kiliko kiyisa kuamusywa na nzia kya kawaida.
eng: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

kam: ADD ni yanangaa undu mailenie na ala angi tondu syana ila angi syiikwatasya niki meika undu meika, undu masomaa syindu kana nundu uima woo ui kiwango kimwe.
eng: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

kam: O undu utonyi wa kukwata umanyi o vamwe na kusoma wavindukie kwa nzia o ila iwetetwe vaa yiulu o ta uu mituki ya kukwata umanyi niyavindukie.
eng: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

kam: Nzia ya kukwata uvoo yii kivathukany'o. Vai nai pressure iulu wa kila mundu kwitwa, ateo utonyi wa kulilikana utumani niw'o wai vata.
eng: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

kam: Kwa undu wa maana, ulilikano usu waetie ũalyũku wi vata kwa nzia ya usomethya na kunyaiikya ũmanyi.
eng: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

kam: Kivathukany'o na primates ila ingi, hominids nisyaekie utumia moko masyo kwa kuthi kana kukua uito kana kusua mitini.
eng: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

kam: Kw'oko na kuu kwa ilai kwithwaa kwianene nginya uasa, wonany'o mwianu kana kw'oko nikutumiawa ukua uito ila itembeete.
eng: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

kam: Kw'oko kwa mundu ni kukuvi kwi kuu, na kwii tuvindi tuungamangu.
eng: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

kam: Mawindi ala matene vyu ma myaka ta milioni ili nginya milioni itatu nimekwonany'a uvinduku wa specilization ya kw'oko kuma locomotion nginya manipulation.
eng: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

kam: Andu amwe maikiiaa kana kwithwa na ndoto sya kwitongoesya mala maingi syi minoo.
eng: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

kam: Kĩtũmĩ kĩnene kya kĩko kĩĩ nũndũ wa ũvangĩthya mũseo wa ndoto ĩla sya nenevĩsye saa katĩ wa nthĩ sya REM.
eng: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

kam: Kwithwa na REMs kila wiyoo, ivindani yii wiw'aa too mweene na mwii uyithwa na thina na kwiyiw'a.
eng: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

kam: ũũ wĩ na mĩnoo ta kũamũka ĩtina wa kĩla ndatĩka mĩongoĩ ilĩ kana mĩongo ĩtatũ wĩloele tiivii.
eng: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

kam: useo kana uthuku witengemea undu akili yaku ikwiyielesya kila utuku ndotoni.
eng: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

kam: Maundu mayaathi nesa kwa Italians ngaliko ya iulu ya Avilika kuma mwambiio. Nthini wa kyumwa kimwe Itali yatangaasa kau wa mwei wa thanthatu 1940, Hussards ma uungelesa ya 11 niyakwatite mateka Fort Capuzzo kuu Libya.
eng: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

kam: Kwisila kuthi mevithite, ngaliko ya utee ya Bardia, Asungu ni mamukwatie munene wa useuvya syindu wa jeshi ya ikumi ya Itali, General Lastucci.
eng: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

kam: Twi mwei wa wathanthatũ matuku 28, Marshall Italo Balbo, Ngavana Mũnene wa nthi ya Libya na mũtiiwa ũnene wa Mussolini, auwaiwe ni mwaki wa kiunyanya ila wevuilaa nthi kuu Tobruk.
eng: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

kam: Ithau yii yeu ya kuuta ni yithaukawa iwangoni syi kivathukanyo, kuma amanyiwa ma yunivasĩtĩ nginya ala me wiani na asembi.
eng: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

kam: Ithau ithaukawa kwa nzia ya nguthu kana andu eli, mwikii wiio umwe ayukita ula ungi.
eng: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

kam: Ngovu ni ithau yila athauki matumiaa tumiti ukuna mivila ilike maimani.
eng: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

kam: Maima ikumi na nyanya ni mathaukawa laundini imwe. Athauki mambiaa ya mbee na maiminiia ya ikumi ya nyanya.
eng: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

kam: Mûthaûki ula ukûkûna makûna manini, kana kûsûa kwa kilavu, aile umina koosi kwa kusinda.
eng: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

kam: Ithau yii yithaukiwa nyekini na nyeki ila yi vakũvi na yiima ni ndile yi ngũvi kute ila ingi na yitawa “the green”.
eng: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

kam: Noethwa nzîa îla yîsîkîe mûno ya ûtalii noyo andû aingî mamîkwatanasya na kûtembea: ûtalii wa kûseûvya îngî.
eng: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

kam: Ĩĩ nĩ ĩla andũ maendaa vandũ ve kĩvathũkany'o vyũ na vala mekalaa kĩla mũthenya kũthyũmũa na kwĩtaanĩthya.
eng: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

kam: Utee wa ukanga, kundu kwi syindu sya kusisya na kambi ni siendawa muno ni atalii.
eng: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

kam: Ethĩwa kĩeleelo kya mundu kuthi vandu ni kwenda umanya maundu mavo ma tene na syithio syoo muthemba uyu wa utalii witawa utalii wa syithio.
eng: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

kam: Atalĩĩ matembea kũndũ kĩvathũkany'o nthĩ kana omakasakũa kũtembea vandũ vamwe.
eng: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

kam: Asungũ ala masũmbikite nthi ino moona ũu ni meetisye ũtethyo.
eng: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

kam: ĩkũndĩ nĩ sya lasĩmĩthasya mwĩ nya ya mbee yĩovo 1st na 3rd New Hampshĩre regĩments ya aũme 200, nthĩ wa kolonel John stark na James Reed (ala ĩtĩma nĩmatwĩkĩe generals).
eng: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

kam: Aume ma Stark meevithite wiioni mwiso wa ngaliko ya yiulu ya vala akoloni mai.
eng: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

kam: Yĩla low tide mavingũie mwanya ũtee wa ũsĩ wa Mystic, ngalĩko ya ĩũlĩ wa umĩloni wa syũa wa Peninsula, mongeleelie wiio kwa mĩtũkĩ na ũkũta mũkuvĩ wa ĩvia ngalĩkonĩ ya ĩũlũ wathelela mũthianĩ wa kĩw'ũ kaũteenĩ kanini ka ũsĩ.
eng: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

kam: Gridley kana Stark aiie kilungu vakuvi vuti iana yimwe (mita miongo itatu) mbee wa wiio na anengane watho kana o na uu ndakaathe mbika ma kawaita mamivitukithye.
eng: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

kam: Vulani ya Amerika yeekwety'e kwambiisya mavithukii kuma ngali itatu syi kivathukany'o.
eng: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

kam: Munene John Cadwalder ai ambiisya mbithũkio ya ita sya Britain ula wi Bordentown ni kenda maikaetewe ũtethyo.
eng: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

kam: Munene wa jeshi James Ewing atwaa asikali ma jeshi maana muonza muingo wa ũsi kũu Trenton Ferry, akoosa kiao kya Assumnpink Creek na kusiia mumaitha wonthe ndakasembe.
eng: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

kam: Nguthu ila nene ya vinya wa aũme 2.400 yakĩlaa usi maili kenda ngaliko ya iulu ya Trenton, na ikaana nguthu ili, kimwe uungu wa Greene na kingi uungu wa Sullivan, ni kana maambiisye ukuna kau wa mbee wa kwakya.
eng: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

kam: Nũndũ wa ũalyũko kuma ĩsemba ya kwota kũthi ya nusu ya maĩli, vata wa mĩtũkĩ yu ti munene mũno naw'o ũũmĩĩsyo ũtw'ĩkĩte wa vata vyũ.
eng: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

kam: Kilasi kya mbee kya miler nusu, mundume utonya usinda ndatika ili, ailwe ni kwithwa e na siviti nzeo, ateo kwi yumiisya kwaile ithwa kwivo saa syonthe sya muisyo.
eng: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

kam: Kũsemba vandũ vaasa ivinda ya mbevo na kũthi njimu ya kuseovya mwii wa iũlu ni nzi nzeo ya kwiseovya weteele ivinda ya kũsemba.
eng: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

kam: Kula nesa kuitumaa asembi ala anini masembe nesa kwi kwoka indi ni kuseo kwa uima woo wa mwii.
eng: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

kam: Kwikala na uima museo wi mbalanzi, kunywa kiw'u nesa, na kuelewa nesa maundu ma kwongeleela maundu ta asu kutumaa musembi ethwa e na mosungio maseo na ingi mayendeew'a ni ithau.
eng: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

kam: Kũsemba vandũ vakũvi ni ĩthaũ ya mbesa nini indĩ kwina maũndũ mate ma w’o ĩũlũ wa mĩio ila yiendekaa ithaũni yiĩ.
eng: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

kam: Syindu no siuwe o undu ikwendeka, indi mbingi syasyo syithiawa na utethyo munini kana vathei iulu wa matokeo.
eng: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

kam: Asembi no mew'e mendeew'a ni kindu onakethwa syiina utethyo mwianiu kwoo.
eng: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

kam: Atom noyoswe ta ĩmwe kwa mavia me vata mũno ma kwaka syĩndũ syonthe.
eng: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

kam: Nĩkĩndũ kĩ vĩnya kũkwatya na kĩthaa na, kwĩanana na Bohr model, nĩũkĩlĩa sya katĩ syĩthaa ĩthyũlũlũkĩtwe nĩ tũlũngũ tũnĩnĩ twitawa elekĩtronĩ, ota ũndũ planetĩ ĩthĩũkaa sũa - sĩsya ĩvĩsa ya 1.1.
eng: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

kam: Nucleus yĩthĩawa na ilungu ilĩ - neurons na protons.
eng: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

kam: Vulotoni syithiawa na uvano wa kwongela wa mwaki wa sitima, indi nasyo niutuloni siyithiawa na mwaki ona vanini. Elekituloni nasyo syithiawa na uvano wa kuola wa mwaki wa sitima.
eng: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

kam: Nĩ kenda kũsĩsya mũwaũ, nĩ lasĩma wambe kũsĩsya vala vekĩkĩe kĩko kyũ nĩ kenda wĩthwe wĩmũsũvĩĩkũ.
eng: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

kam: Ni wailitwe kumanya muungamo wa muumiw'a withi vakuvi nake na syonekany'o ila syukaa o mana.
eng: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

kam: Ila uumia uitata kutetheesya, no ukite kwananga maundu vyu.
eng: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

kam: Ukunikili ũu weethiie kuthĩnĩka ngoo mũno, wia na kwona thina ni syithiawa ivinda ya woo na kwonza kwa mũongo wa nthi.
eng: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

kam: No mauito ma mathina, ti kukw'a ngoo na wia waí kauta kila kyumwa nundu wa mavinda ma PA.
eng: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

kam: Ala me isesoni yimwe meendaa ukwatwa mbau kwa mwonekano muthuku wa woo uivathukany'a ivathukany'o sya woo utathelaa na kwiw'a utemwianie nundu wa kutinda uendete.
eng: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

kam: Woni, kana utonyi wa kwona itengemeaa na mutalatala wa mamutha ma kumanya kana metho.
eng: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

kam: Ve mithemba mingi ya mumbo wa metho, kivathukany'o kiyongeleka kwianana na mawendi ma I kyumbe.
eng: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

kam: Kuseuvw'a na miundo yi kivathukanio syithiawa na mautonyi me kivathukany'o, syithiawa na nivindukaa mituki kwianana na uvinduku wa makumbo na syithiawa na levoo syi kivathukany'o sya usungio, o ingi nisyendaa nzia syi kivathukany'o ni kana sielewe ni kila i kwikiwa na namba syi kivathukany'o ithukume nesa.
eng: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

kam: Utalo ni muvulany'o wa syindu sya kivathukany'o nthini wa kisio vulani.
eng: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

kam: Ila andu oonthe mavyanene me kwa populeshoni vamwe na tavia syoo metawa monomorphic.
eng: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

kam: Ila andũ moonania mithemba kauta ya tavia na methaa masensye maketha na tavia mbingi.
eng: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

kam: Mithwa íatianíaa na itua kundu kivathukany'o.
eng: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

kam: Ivinda yasyo ya kutembea, nguku itembea kwatuka na iithyumua ivinda ya muthenya.
eng: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.
